name: ai-marketing-claude-code-skills
title_zh: 营销框架不产空话，直接产出可执行任务清单
tagline_zh: 别再收藏一堆「定位画布」「漏斗模型」吃灰。这套 Skill 让 Claude Code 按框架一步步替你干活——从…
tagline_en: Stop hoarding framework PDFs. These skills make Claude Code execute them step-by-step—from competitor teardown to.
desc_en: Marketing frameworks that AI actually executes. Designed for Claude Code, but could be used for OpenClaw, etc.
why_zh: 把营销方法论编译成 Agent 能跑的指令集，不是给你看解释，是给你交作业。框架是入口，执行是出口。
why_en: It compiles marketing methodology into agent-runnable instructions—not explanations, but deliverables. Frameworks are the entry.
limit_zh: 只覆盖营销策略与内容生成类框架，不含投放调优、数据分析或 CRM 操作。产出物是任务清单和草稿。
limit_en: Covers only marketing strategy & content frameworks, not ad optimization, analytics, or CRM. Outputs are task lists & drafts—no compliance or brand.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Marketing frameworks that output executable task lists
